samples.description: Fit-specific 1987-2003 firm-year populations for all frozen Tables 3-5 fits, with preserved 1985-2004 accounting history used to construct lagged/lead values and average-assets scaling.

assumptions: Source-defined Table 3-5 equation and fit-specific flagged sample; current-vintage local data, SIC 6000-6999 financial-firm classification, exclusion of missing SICH, and the AQC acquisition screen are best-effort. Missing AQC is treated as no recorded acquisition.
OLS estimator and the source-silent covariance choices are documented in design.md.

For each monetary construct, require nonmissing syntactically valid ISO currency codes and equality across every actual period used; leave incompatible or unknown inputs unavailable without unvalidated FX translation. Current/prior matching is required for average assets and lagged accounting differences.

Source-defined Table 3-5 equation and fit-specific flagged sample; current-vintage local data, SIC 6000-6999 financial-firm classification, exclusion of missing SICH, and the AQC acquisition screen are best-effort. Missing AQC is treated as no recorded acquisition.
OLS estimator and the source-silent covariance choices are documented in design.md.
Industry t-statistics use the cross-sectional coefficient distribution; qualifying SIC3 fits require at least 30 observations and at least five observations for each included loss dummy.
